gen-gf-autour-one-gf-epunda-slab: Round, loud and unfussy: Autour One draws its curves with a clear channel running into each letter. And Epunda Slab follows as a text serif, with tall rounded lowercase and a gaping c that keeps a long passage easy going.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-fauna-one: Autour One stamps its headings with a marker-nib line that ignores direction, with no hairline-to-stem shift anywhere. Fauna One settles in underneath, its tall middle band and shallow ascenders making a quieter literary counterpart.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hanuman: Never a thin stroke or a thick one: Autour One has no hairline-to-stem shift, just bold, expressive curves. Hanuman sits below it as a refined serif with a high-waisted lowercase.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-kadwa: Kadwa brings a classic serif, editorial in feel, with open-ended curves and a large x-height. Autour One does the louder job, its bold s keeping spine and terminals at matching thickness, while Kadwa handles the steady work of the text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text gives the page a literary text serif, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and a big visible entrance into each curve. But Autour One is the one for headings, outlining its counters in a single steady thickness that the body never tries to copy.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-pridi: Pridi leads with small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized, and generous space between curve ends and the stem. And Autour One sets its dowel-like stems and bent-dowel arcs above, so the heavy heading and the refined serif text both stay easy to follow.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-scope-one: Autour One has a texture like neatly bent pipe cleaner, bold and expressive in every heading it sets. And Scope One carries on as a text serif, its counters spilling outward, so a long passage feels open and unhurried.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-slabo-13px: Heavy, expressive and round: Autour One draws vertical and horizontal strokes at identical weight. Slabo 13px settles beside it as a bookish serif, its tall a, e and s opening wide against the bolder heading.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified is the mood Suwannaphum sets, a serif with a c as open as a bent paperclip and a high, squared-off x-height. Autour One answers above it with stems matching its hairlines, because it has none.
